scope: Saved weighted posterior recovery for the current5Hz experiment; no likelihood or GPU sampling performed by this analyzer
method: All nested samples with normalized exp(log_weights); inverse empirical-CDF equal-tail90/95/99% intervals. ESS measures weight concentration only.
angular_method: RA period2pi and psi periodpi, with injection-centered unwrapping for equal-tail intervals/CDFs; circular means/resultants and shortest contiguous arcs also supplied. psi_phase_equivalent folds modulo pi/2 because a common waveform sign is marginalized by the dominant-mode phase likelihood.
interpretation: Recovery assessment concerns posterior samples; evidence values are optional descriptive metadata, not a pass/fail criterion.
One noisy injection need not lie inside every marginal interval; these ranks alone do not establish bias or failed coverage.

Shared offsets across matched runs can reflect the fixed noise realization, prior geometry, or shared sampling limitations; repeated noise/sampler seeds and independent posterior checks are needed to distinguish them.
Differences between these matched-noise runs describe trajectory sensitivity and possible mixing limitations; posterior-weight ESS does not make those differences statistically independent.
Marginal interval inclusion does not establish joint recovery, especially across separated sky modes. Phase_c was analytically marginalized and is not a recovered sampled parameter.
